scope: read-only exact fixed upstream normal/tangent rule check; no MRI or original executable run

rules.corner_and_edge_mrisNormalize: float d from square sum; only d>0 divides components. d==0 retains zero and returns zero. No FZERO threshold or epsilon.
rules.corner_normal: two edges use mrisNormalize; cross result uses mrisNormalize when UnitizeNormalFace is enabled, so true zero cross remains zero.
rules.vertex_normal: incident corner normals accumulated in ordered float buffer; positive normalized length succeeds; actual zero sum enters pending retry rather than immediate 0/0.
rules.tangent_normalize: V3_NORMALIZE uses float length and FZERO; if abs(length)<FLT_EPSILON multiplier is 1, else reciprocal length.
rules.vertex_retry: up to five trials; sorted pending vertices; deterministic fnv_hash perturbation with 0.001mm radius applied to affected vertices/neighbours. This is a separate branch and is not justified merely by zero corner normals.
rules.face_unit_normal: Triangle area is V3_LEN(cross)*0.5; V3_NORMALIZE uses FZERO(length) to retain the unnormalized cross when abs(length)<FLT_EPSILON, otherwise divides by length. True zero cross remains zero, area remains zero. This differs from corner mrisNormalize(d>0).
rules.overlap_stop: Both source stops exist: parms->t > min_neg_iter + 1000, and parms->t - parms->start_t > parms->niterations. The source caller must set niterations; default1000 cannot be assumed source-equivalent without checking the caller.
